title: Paper Item Frame Recipe | 用纸合成展示框
description: Adding a recipe for item frames using paper instead of leather. 加入一个用纸代替皮革的展示框合成配方。
body:
A simple datapack adding a recipe for item frames using paper instead of leather, to make it more realistic when using the corresponding resourcepack.

一个小数据包，加了个用纸而不是皮革的展示框合成，搭配纸质展示框材质更真实。

Resourcepack | 材质包： [https://modrinth.com/datapack/paper-item-frames](https://modrinth.com/datapack/paper-item-frames)
